title: Lamb Satay
description: A traditional Malaysian dish of marinated meat skewers, typically served with spicy peanut sauce. This recipe is perfect for a dinner party or special occasion.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, coconut milk, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, and coriander.
3. Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
4. Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Bake the satay in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
7. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
